english.title: Fail to give a local authority a notice cancelling the initial notice when required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[carrying]_
(B)_[intending to carry]_

out work to which an initial notice under Part II of the Building Act 1984, which was in force, related, and to whom it appeared that the approved inspector was no longer willing or able to carry out

(C)_[his]_
(D)_[her]_

functions with respect to some or all of that work, failed without reasonable excuse to give to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) a notice that you were required to give by section 52(3) of the Act
